_what: Territory War board for Astra. DEFENCE IS THE PRODUCT: a set squad banks a flat +30 the instant it is placed, win or lose, and there is no per-player cap. Squad order IS placement order, front band first.
_supersedes: scripts/tw_wall.py's generated wall, which built squads by shared-faction-tag affinity and left four Galactic Legends (JMK, JML, Jabba, GL Ahsoka) with no TW squad at all.
_sources: swgoh.gg /tier-list/gac/ S82, four cuts (Kyber-D1 and all-league, most-played and best-build) - scraped 2026-08-26, data/meta/tierlist_5v5_*.json. This page IS league-scoped; /gac/squads/ is not.
HotUtils account/data/all 2026-08-26 - per-unit twOmiCount/gacOmiCount, first-party omicron ground truth.
swgoh.wiki Territory_War - banner table, gating, 5-character squads.
swgoh.gg /stats/ability-report/?type=omicron&fo=territory-wars - the authoritative 56-unit TW omicron set.
_rules: Prefer the KYBER-validated build over an all-league 'best build': best-build is a post-hoc maximum and is upward-biased at small n (GL Rey reads 57.2% on n=101 all-league vs 29.1% on n=1,901 in Kyber).

A published GAC rate is a BOUND, not a value. Grand-Arena omicrons are 100% inert in TW, so a squad carrying them is OVERSTATED; a squad carrying TW omicrons is UNDERSTATED, because they sat inert through every battle swgoh.gg measured. Squads with no omicron transfer clean.

Net(attack) = 20p - 6U. A clear pays at most 20 regardless of unit count; a 5-unit wall banks 30, so each unit carries 6 banners of placement value. Break-even at U = 3.33 - which is why the offence bank is 1, 4 and 5 units and not three 5-unit squads.
Defence quality has ZERO banner value. Hold% buys denial only, and denial is worth 2.3x more in a front territory (2,970) than a back one (1,290) because the front gates the whole lane behind it.

bands._why: placement's split. Front slots are guild-wide, first-come and DO fill; a weak wall in a front slot is a slot no guildmate can use. 14 is where this roster's quality cliff sits.

defense.name: Kelleran Beq
defense.why: 2 live TW omicrons. Lead gives +500% Defense and he cannot be defeated while any ally holds Protection. Measured 7 squads to clear — the biggest attempt-eater observed.

defense.name: Lord Vader
defense.why: Needs no omicron. Cheap GAC counters are omicron-gated to GAC (Bo-Katan's ignore-taunt dies in TW). Measured 3–7 squads every round.

defense.name: Boss Nass
defense.why: 28.2% Kyber-D1 (n=3,290) and a live TW omicron that was inert in that measurement — per-turn self-dispel, 20% Protection regen, Daze/Stun cleanse. Lower bound.

defense.name: Supreme Leader Kylo Ren
defense.why: 33.3% Kyber-D1 (n=60) corroborated by 33.9% all-league (n=2,784). Zero omicron dependency, so the rate transfers to TW intact — the most trustworthy number on the board.
defense.hu_name: TW F04 Supreme Leader Kylo Ren

defense.name: Rey
defense.why: 31% (n=13.3K) on the Sortie build. ⚠ ORDER-SENSITIVE — 50R-T must sit before BENSOLO so her unique resolves first and grants him VIP→Stealth; Rey is untargetable until he dies. Cal earns his slot on base kit (LS-UFU doubling lands on Rey herself).

defense.name: Satele Shan
defense.why: 28.2% on n=5,235 — the best-sampled wall on the board, and the measurement includes Juhani.

defense.name: Admiral Trench
defense.why: 3 live TW omicrons incl. the basic granting undispellable, unresistable Ability Block. Lower bound.

defense.name: Dark Trooper Moff Gideon
defense.why: 3 live TW omicrons: undispellable turn-1 Taunt, IR +75% Health, taunt dispels all enemy buffs, unresistable Healing Immunity. Lower bound.
defense.hu_name: TW F08 Dark Trooper Moff Gideon

defense.name: Leia Organa
defense.why: 23.7% (n=2,097) most-played. ⚠ Drogan/Raddus/Rex omicrons are GAC-tagged → upper bound in TW.

defense.name: Baylan Skoll
defense.why: Shin Hati's TW omicron is live: all allies +50% Max Health AND Max Protection until she first dies. Baylan's own omicrons are GAC-only. Zaalbar is the Kyber-measured body, not Hondo.

defense.name: Queen Amidala
defense.why: 20.0% on n=3,346, one of the best-sampled rows in the file, and Master Qui-Gon's TW omicron is live → lower bound.

defense.name: GL Ahsoka
defense.why: 8.9% Kyber on n=3,546, the largest Kyber sample of any GL wall. Two unapplied TW omicrons (Padawan Sabine, General Syndulla) are the biggest buyable upgrade on the board.

defense.name: Cassian Andor
defense.why: 16.3% Kyber-D1 (n=1,973). Cinta's TW omicron is a MUST-HAVE and unbought → lower bound once purchased.

defense.name: Rotta the Hutt
defense.why: 15.8% Kyber-D1 (n=1,574), his measured most-played build. Rotta's 3 omicrons are GAC-mode → upper bound; he keeps base-kit Tank Taunt and the Bleed/Detonator lead engine.

defense.name: Jabba the Hutt
defense.why: 7.6% Kyber (n=776) — but a lower bound: Embo's TW omicron (BH +40% Max Protection, continuous regen, 5% TM per debuffed-ally hit) was inert throughout. The only Jabba build with a live TW upgrade path.

defense.name: Great Mothers
defense.why: Both Great Mothers omicrons are TW MUST-HAVE and unbought — five in-place full resurrections once purchased. ⚠ Merrin, Morgan and Asajj omicrons are all GAC-mode, so Great Mothers' two are the squad's *only* possible live tech.

defense.name: The Stranger
defense.why: Maul (Hate-Fueled)'s 3 TW omicrons are live (100 Edge-of-Madness stacks at start). ⚠ Stranger's and Starkiller's omicrons are all GAC → dead here. Rebuilt after Juhani went to Satele; REY = Rey (Scavenger), from the Kyber-measured build.

defense.name: Bo-Katan
defense.why: 21.0% (n=2,911), the Kyber-validated Bo-Katan Kryze variant.

defense.name: General Skywalker
defense.why: 12.3% (n=4,581). GAS is `o0`, so nothing is lost to mode-gating.

defense.name: Jedi Master Kenobi
defense.why: 16.7% (n=5,228) most-played. ⚠ Exposed to Grand Inquisitor's "Ready to Die?" instant-defeat-no-revive on Jedi — do not front-band it.

defense.name: General Grievous
defense.why: Droideka's unbought TW omicron revives the entire squad at 100% Health when he first dies while Marked. Grievous himself has no omicron at all — one point of failure.

defense.name: Hera Syndulla
defense.why: 11.5% (n=1,247); Hera's TW omicron is live → lower bound.

defense.name: ISB
defense.why: KX's unapplied TW omicron gives all allies +50% Max Health and Protection all battle, behind a 3-turn opening taunt with Retribution.

defense.name: New Republic (Carson Teva)
defense.why: Measured 17.0% (n=1,532); NR tanks open with Retribution and anything 300+ Speed above Teva eats irresistible Speed Down.

defense.name: Constables + Jawas (Cobb Vanth)
defense.why: Measured 16.7% (n=3,775) — the best-sampled non-meta wall Astra can field; Nebit's detonators behind CUP and Lobot bodies.

defense.name: Sith Triumvirate (Traya)
defense.why: Isolate removes one attacker from the fight entirely — unresistable, undispellable, no buffs, no out-of-turn actions.

defense.name: First Order (Phasma TW omicron)
defense.why: TW omicron applied: heals on every out-of-turn attack and stacks permanent Offense plus team TM on every Advantage. It snowballs.
defense.hu_name: TW M13 First Order (Phasma TW omicron)

defense.name: Sith Empire (Malgus)
defense.why: Immune to TM reduction while debuffed and +10% Crit Chance and 15 Speed per debuff on themselves — debuffing them speeds them up.

defense.name: Imperial Troopers (Veers)
defense.why: Veers' unique gives the whole team a turn-meter cascade every time an ally dies, behind Shoretrooper's taunt and Regroup.

defense.name: Empire (Thrawn)
defense.why: Fracture removes a unit from the fight for two turns with no counterplay; Thrawn feeds 15% TM to every Empire special.

defense.name: Tuskens
defense.why: At 10 Momentum a targeted Tusken unresistably stuns every attacking enemy and takes a bonus turn; DoT-immune and they heal off DoTs.

defense.name: Ewoks
defense.why: Paploo to Logray assist gives team-wide TM, Foresight, Offense Up and Advantage before the attacker moves.

defense.name: CLS Rebels
defense.why: Exact measured build (8.2%, n=2,129); crushing counters plus Protection regeneration, and the AI needs no decisions to play it.

defense.name: Mauldalorians
defense.why: Measured build (8.2%, n=844); Maul's Mandalorian lead over the dodge and counter layer, all four allies R7+.

defense.name: Bounty Hunters (Aurra contract)
defense.why: Built to complete the Contract before the enemy moves, firing all Payouts; Bossk then taunts and regenerates through the rest.

defense.name: Rebel Fighters (Mon Mothma)
defense.why: Mon Mothma cannot be targeted and is taunt-immune, so you must clear four Rebel Fighters who assist each other every turn.

defense.name: Smugglers (Dash Rendar)
defense.why: Measured 7.9% (n=232); Prepared re-applies itself and every crit feeds team turn meter.

defense.name: Wookiees (Tarfful TW omicron)
defense.why: TW omicron applied: the first time each Wookiee dies, every Wookiee refreshes cooldowns and recovers 100% Health. Five resets.

defense.name: Imperial Troopers (Iden)
defense.why: Solo-leader clause gives +100% counter chance and, in Arenas, +35% Max Health and Protection with recovery on out-of-turn attacks.

defense.name: Nightsisters (Talzin)
defense.why: Mass revive plus Zombie's respawning taunt — you kill the same units three times, and no ability combo is required of the AI.

defense.name: Bad Batch (Mercenary)
defense.why: Batcher lets them ignore taunts and Crosshair bursts; measured only 7.0% on defence, so it is a MID wall at best.

defense.name: Aphras Droids (BT-1)
defense.why: Measured build (23.1%, n=760) minus Aphra; 0-0-0's torture stacking and BT-1's AoE, uniform R7.

defense.name: Bad Batch (classic)
defense.why: Stealth forces every attack onto Wrecker, who pre-taunts and AoE-stuns; stealthed units cannot be counter-attacked.

defense.name: Rebel Fighters (Wedge)
defense.why: Baze and Chirrut are a real sustain pair — heal-over-time on every crit behind Baze's taunt; uniform R7, zero zetas.

defense.name: Unaligned Force Users (Cere)
defense.why: All five carry the UFU tag so Cere's Force-echo buffs reach everyone; Taron's self-sustain makes it a grind rather than a burst-down.

defense.name: Emperor Palpatine
defense.why: ⚠ BACK ONLY. Mara Jade's omicron — including her 100% Turn Meter — is gated on *"if the enemy Leader is not a Galactic Legend."* Blank against any GL-led attack.

defense.name: Geonosian Brood Alpha
defense.why: ⚠ BACK ONLY. Poggle's omicron is gated on *"if there are no enemy Galactic Legends."* Same failure mode as #21. Measured 3 squads to clear when attacked by non-GL squads.

defense.name: Old Republic (Carth)
defense.why: Carth gives +30% Potency, Tenacity and Crit Avoidance and an 80% assist call on every basic, with team healing per DoT tick.

defense.name: Galactic Republic Jedi (Qui-Gon)
defense.why: Coherent Jedi block; Qui-Gon's lead gives offense and turn meter on assists. R5.6 average is the weakness.

defense.name: Resistance Veterans (Holdo)
defense.why: All five carry the Resistance tag; zero zetas, so this is coherent body count rather than a threat.

defense.name: Hoth Rebels (Officer Leia)
defense.why: Coherent Rebel block under a Rebel lead; Old Ben R7 upgrades it and his taunt-on-death forces a longer fight.

defense.name: Solo crew / Scoundrels
defense.why: Scoundrel block; Sana's assists and Boba's burn behind Young Lando's lead. Uniform R7 bodies.

defense.name: Pirates (Hondo)
defense.why: Profit-stacking crew; Hondo dispels all debuffs on Mercenary and Scoundrel allies then calls an assist and assists himself.

defense.name: Jedi Vanguard B (Temple)
defense.why: All-Jedi block after Ki-Adi-Mundi replaced Zeb; zero zetas and zero omicrons, so it is a speed bump, not a wall.

defense.name: Jawa / spare bodies
defense.why: Three spare Jawas plus two bodies. Nebit leads the Cobb build instead, so the TW omicron does not fire here. Pure body count.

defense.name: Sith / dark bodies (Sidious)
defense.why: Shared Dark Side alignment under a Sith lead; three of five get Sidious's bonus. Buying his TW omicron promotes this squad.

defense.name: Clone / Republic bodies
defense.why: Shared Light Side alignment; the weakest squad on the board and an absolute last resort for the deepest back territory.

defense.name: Ewok B-team (Teebo)
defense.why: R8.6 average, the highest in the catalogue — three spare Ewoks plus the only two faction-less units, both R10. Stat bulk, no synergy.

defense.name: Resistance JTR
defense.why: Expose on crits feeds team turn meter while every special drains the attacker's; Rey's Foresight wastes damage. Nine zetas invested.

defense.name: Rogue One
defense.why: Spark of Rebellion converts into a six-buff suite the moment it is dispelled, so dispel-based attackers buff them; K-2SO taunts and counters.

defense.name: Resistance + bodies
defense.why: Three Resistance under Finn's lead plus two high-relic bodies. No synergy for the last two - a filled slot banks the same +30. BACK only.

offense.name: SEE solo
offense.for: 84% solo clear on n=2,466. The only banner-POSITIVE squad on the board: Net = 20p - 6U = +10.8, because a clear pays 20 regardless of unit count while a 5-unit wall banks 30. No omicron anywhere in it, so the rate transfers from Grand Arena to TW intact.

offense.name: JML
offense.for: 93% on n=4,609 at only four units (the 5-unit variant is 87.4% on n=871 - worse AND dearer). JML has essentially no defensive usage in the tracked population. Jedi Knight Cal's omicrons are Territory Battles, so they were inert in the measurement and stay inert here: zero translation loss.

offense.name: Inquisitorius
offense.for: Grand Inquisitor's three TW omicrons are an OFFENCE package - ignores Taunt, and at 6 Purge stacks instantly deletes a Jedi with no revive. Its defensive row is 10.3% and that row contains Third Sister, whom Astra does not own, so his version is worse. A squad that genuinely does not belong on a wall.
